Diagnose the appropriate outcome distribution from data

Source: R/data_handler.R
diagnose_distribution.Rd

Heuristic rules in decreasing priority:

  • Strictly non-negative integers with variance > 1.5 * mean -> "poisson" (LightGBM's poisson objective handles overdispersion through tuning; a true Negative Binomial objective is not available in stock LightGBM).

  • Non-negative continuous with at least 5 percent zeros -> "tweedie".

  • Strictly positive continuous -> "gamma".

  • Otherwise -> "gaussian".

Usage

diagnose_distribution(y)

Arguments

y

Numeric vector of outcomes.

Value

A list with family (the detected objective string) and reasoning (a short human-readable description of the rule that fired).
